reviews.title: Mission bug issues
reviews.text:
I really like the concept behind Wayk. The idea of having to complete a mission to turn off your alarm is one of the best approaches I’ve seen for actually getting out of bed, and when it works, it’s incredibly effective.

Unfortunately, I’ve had repeated issues with some of the missions. The sky photo mission often doesn’t recognize the photo correctly, and the squats mission frequently fails to detect my movement even when I’m doing the exercise correctly. The most frustrating part is that when the app gets stuck, there’s no way to retry, skip, or manually resolve the mission. The alarm just keeps going, and the only way I’ve found to stop it is by deleting the app entirely.

I really want to keep using Wayk because the concept is fantastic, but these bugs make it unreliable when you need it most. Adding a fallback option when mission detection fails would make a huge difference.

reviews.title: Potentially Misleading Paywall and Lack of Transparency
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app expecting a functional alarm clock as advertised, but my experience raised serious concerns regarding the way the product is presented to users. Upon opening the app, a substantial portion of what appears to be basic functionality is immediately restricted behind a paywall, preventing users from meaningfully evaluating the service without agreeing to a paid subscription.

From a consumer standpoint, this approach may be perceived as misleading. The app’s listing and presentation reasonably imply that users will be able to access and test core alarm clock features before being required to make a financial commitment. Instead, users are quickly funneled toward payment with little opportunity to determine whether the product actually meets their needs.

Practices like this risk undermining consumer trust and may raise questions about compliance with platform guidelines regarding transparency in subscriptions and in-app purchases. Users should carefully review what functionality is actually available before agreeing to any payment terms.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app and would advise potential users to consider alternative alarm clock applications that provide clear, transparent access to their basic features.

reviews.title: Good idea in theory but not in practice, design flaw and up charge for nothing
reviews.text:
I tried it to see if it would help me get out of bed and it’s safe to say that while this app is very pretty it isn’t pushy enough. 

You set an alarm and then chose a mission, simple enough? 

When the alarm finally goes off it give you an off slide button and a mission button and personally it doesn’t work!

I’m going to slide the button to turn it off! I’m not going to pick mission cause I want the alarm to turn off. 

The app shouldn’t give you the option! If you’re a person who genuinely struggled to get up then you need to be given a mission to turn the alarm off. 

Furthermore the sounds it offers you are very lowkey and not loud enough, and even if they give you the chance to make yourself a jingle you have to pay extra which in my opinion it’s not worth the 20 dollar monthly subscription. 

Unfortunately I will be canceling, waste of money.
